name: Chaiqian Diqiu ji Aiqing Shigu
source:
"We regret to inform you that the Earth has been demolished." Coming next—a "Human Observation Documentary" starring "Landmine Girl" (self-proclaimed) and "Nerd" (so-called).

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872710]Steam[/url]]

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3872710]Steam[/url]]
